names.item.simplyswords.gem_description: Can be socketed into a matching
names.item.simplyswords.gem_description2: gem socket on a unique weapon.
names.item.simplyswords.remnant_description: Smith with a Runic Tablet or
names.item.simplyswords.remnant_description2: Netherite Ingot to create a gem that can be socketed into unique weapons.
names.item.simplyswords.contained_remnant_desc: Stabilised and contained energy sourced from remnants.
It seems to react when near some surfaces.
Keeping this item in your inventory may yield further insights.
Try keeping this in your inventory alongside a Runic Tablet while exploring the End dimension.
names.item.simplyswords.contained_remnant.even: A Remnant in your inventory seems to have changed form
A Remnant in your inventory is acting strangely
The Remnant seems to be reacting to a nearby block
names.item.simplyswords.tampered_remnant_descr: It appears to have been tampered with somehow...
names.item.simplyswords.decayingrelicsworditem: Try keeping this in your inventory while exploring the deepest, darkest depths of the Overworld.
names.item.simplyswords.magicythe.event: Your Decaying Relic has begun making sounds
names.item.simplyswords.magicythe.event2: Your Decaying Relic seems to be reacting to this area
names.item.simplyswords.magiblade.event: Your Decaying Relic seems to be quivering
names.item.simplyswords.magiblade.event2: Your Decaying Relic seems gravitated to the block beneath you
names.item.simplyswords.magispear.event: Your Decaying Relic seems to have been influenced by something
names.item.simplyswords.magispear.event2: Your Decaying Relic seems to be reacting to the darkness
names.effect.simplyswords.gloam_grasp.descript: The Gloam has rooted you in place.
names.effect.simplyswords.blood_plague.descrip: When struck, spreads Bleed to nearby enemies.
names.effect.simplyswords.bloodwake_frenzy.des: Increases attack speed by 10% per nearby bleeding enemy counted.
names.item.simplyswords.firesworditem.tooltip2: Chance on hit to spew forth explosive brimstone.
Summon a Brimstone Claymore above the target that pulses area damage before plunging into the ground.
names.item.simplyswords.bramblesworditem.toolt: Unique Effect: Grasp of the Wild
Send forth a living bramble that binds the target and nearby enemies together.
On hit, send a bramble from your previous target to your current target, damaging and slowing enemies in its path.
Damage dealt to one bound enemy echoes through the others.
names.item.simplyswords.stormsworditem.tooltip: Weapon hits cause enemies to become Conductive.
Summon a mobile storm that repeatedly strikes nearby enemies before ending in a powerful thunderclap.
Conductive enemies release a smaller thunderclap when struck.
names.item.simplyswords.watchersworditem.toolt: Your weapon hits build up to %d Dread on targets, summoning a bat for each stack.
names.item.simplyswords.watchersworditem.wargl: Release your bats through nearby enemies afflicted with Dread. Strike and siphon life for every Dread stack consumed.
names.item.simplyswords.watchersworditem.claym: A stream of bats repeatedly tear into the enemy before delivering a final attack based on the targets missing health.
At maximum Dread, enemies left below %d%% health are executed.
Killing the target resets the cooldown.
names.item.simplyswords.devourerclaymoreitem.t: Deflecting an attack opens an abyssal maw beneath the attacker, damaging nearby enemies and dragging them inward.
The mass spreads Gloam as it lashes up to %d nearby enemies, drags them into its core, and feeds upon them.
The mass grows as it feeds, before collapsing and releasing its captives after %.1f seconds.
A deflection near your Devouring Mass feeds it and redirects the drag toward its core.
Launch an abyssal seed that blooms into a floating, living mass at the targeted location.
names.item.simplyswords.gloam.tooltip: Gloam slows and latches onto enemies that linger within it. Hostile deaths feed its growth.
names.item.simplyswords.plaguesworditem.toolti: Weapon hits inflict the target with fever. At %d fever, a plague bell tolls and damages nearby enemies.
The toll spreads fever and can cascade through up to %d enemies.
Hits can convert positive effects into ailments, granting bonus fever and empowering the next toll.
names.item.simplyswords.emberiresworditem.tool: Channel energy into the blade. Upon release, send forth fiery hot shrapnel at your aimed target, dealing increased damage the longer the channel.
Releasing the channel within the last second allows you to fire an additional piece of shrapnel.
When releasing shrapnel, you have a chance relative to your channel time to gain Speed, Haste, and Strength.
Unique Effect: Chains of the Furnace
Weapon hits can brand and ignite enemies, making them easier to bind with furnace chains.
Bind nearby enemies with molten chains. Striking bound enemies echoes fire damage to other bound enemies.
As the chains are stretched, they build pressure. Attacking bound enemies also builds pressure.
At maximum pressure, your next strike shatters every remaining chain, dealing area damage.
names.item.simplyswords.ferocitysworditem.tool: Chance on hit to gain Ferocity, increasing attack speed and stacking up to %d times.
While you have Ferocity, your hits can trigger Crescendo strikes that damage and knock back nearby enemies.
Consume all Ferocity to empower your next successful hit with Grand Crescendo.
names.item.simplyswords.rendsworditem.tooltip2: Chance on hit to inflict stacking weakening effects.
names.item.simplyswords.rendsworditem.tooltip4: Consume all stacks from surrounding foes, damaging them and healing you relative to the stacks consumed.
names.item.simplyswords.soulstalkersworditem.t: Abyssal tendrils periodically emerge from your back and pierce nearby enemies.
Rise upon six abyssal limbs to stride across the terrain. Charge jump to perform a directional leap.
While in-use, footsteps spread Gloam and damage nearby enemies, while weapon swings release shadow cleaves.
names.item.simplyswords.soulsworditem.tooltip2: Two soul lanterns orbit you, damaging enemies they touch. Weapon and lantern hits increase their orbit speed.
names.item.simplyswords.soulsworditem.tooltip4: Summon two additional soul lanterns for a short duration.
names.item.simplyswords.stealsworditem.tooltip: Chance on hit to steal soul debt. Kills steal additional debt.
Spend all soul debt to blink behind a target and backstab them, scaling up to 5x weapon damage.
names.item.simplyswords.soulpyresworditem.tool: Cause the landscape around you to shift into the nether. Slaying enemies within this malformed landscape causes it to grow larger.
While active, you gain knockback resistance and take 50% reduced damage.
Defeated enemies grant you souls, which are periodically fired as homing projectiles.
names.item.simplyswords.frostfallsworditem.too: Throw Frostfall forward. Airtime and angle affect impact damage.
After landing, Frostfall pulses 5 times, damaging, slowing,  and pulling enemies.
names.item.simplyswords.moltenedgesworditem.to: Dealing or receiving damage builds Heat, increasing damage dealt and received.
At maximum Heat, deal 50% more damage, take 100% more damage, and become ignited.
Vent the stored heat, creating a molten shockwave. While venting, weapon swings release magma ruptures.
Heat is lost when Molten Edge is no longer wielded.
names.item.simplyswords.livyatansworditem.tool: Throw Livyatan forward. Airtime and angle affect impact damage.
On return, Livyatan creates a wave that pulls enemies, and has a chance to strike them with lightning.
Has innate Loyalty III. Weapon swings release a damaging wave.
names.item.simplyswords.icewhispersworditem.to: While wielded, gain a frost aura that deals damage and slows enemies within %d blocks.
Ice comets crash down around you for a duration, dealing area damage where they land.
names.item.simplyswords.arcanethystsworditem.t: Chance on hit to levitate your target.
For a short duration, lift nearby medium-sized enemies with arcane force, then slam them into the ground.
Chance on hit to refresh ability cooldown.
Charge your weapon, becoming immune to damage.
Once charged, dash through enemies and release chain lightning for each instance of damage you would have received while charging.
names.item.simplyswords.stormsedgesworditem.to: Chance on hit to refresh ability cooldown.
Become lightning and dash forward, gaining invulnerability and tearing through enemies before releasing a thunderclap.
names.item.simplyswords.stormscalesworditem.to: While you have a Stormscale planted in the ground, your melee attacks trigger area damage around it.
Plant a spectral glaive at the targeted location and tether it to you.
Each melee attack you perform increases its pulse damage and radius by 1%, stacking up to 80%.
names.item.simplyswords.ionbound_stormscaleswo: Periodically generate up to 3 Ion Cubes while wielded.
When receiving a single large hit of damage, consume an ion cube to negate the damage and surround yourself with a protective field for 2 seconds.
Consume a cube to create an ion corridor that pushes enemies inward before slamming shut.
Activate again within 1 second of the slam to consume another cube and channel a steerable energy beam for 3 seconds, repeatedly damaging and paralysing enemies for 5 seconds.
Your movement and aim are greatly slowed while channelling the beam.
names.item.simplyswords.lichbladesworditem.too: Tortured souls radiate from you, damaging any nearby enemies.
Command your souls to attack a distant target, dealing rapid damage. Chance to siphon health.
After the attack subsides, your souls return to you and, when reaching you, grant you absorption.
On hit, spend a Storm Charge to fire chain lightning between nearby enemies.
Focus energy to a single point of your blade, becoming briefly immune to incoming damage.
Perfectly timing this ability triggers a counterattack and grants Storm Charges.
names.item.simplyswords.shadowmistsworditem.to: Chance on hit to summon a shadow clone that repeats your attack.
Gain brief immunity and rapidly shadowstep between nearby enemies, striking each for weapon damage.
names.item.simplyswords.harbingersworditem.too: Chance on hit to inflict weakness.
Summons an Abyssal Battle Standard that pulls, damages, and slows enemies whilst periodically granting haste to friendly players within its vicinity.
names.item.simplyswords.sunfiresworditem.toolt: Chance on hit to regenerate health.
Summons a Righteous Battle Standard that ignites, damages, and slows enemies whilst periodically granting strength and health to friendly players within its vicinity.
names.item.simplyswords.whisperwindsworditem.t: Chance on hit to refresh ability cooldown.
Perform a swift forward dash, gaining resistance and absorption. Enemies caught in the path take damage after a short delay.
Targets struck by Shadow Rend suffer a Corrupted Wound for %ss.
Striking a wounded target with Dreadwhisper guarantees a critical hit and ruptures the wound.
Become a wall of dark energy, surge through enemies, and leave Gloam in your wake.
Each enemy in the path takes a weapon hit, suffers a Corrupted Wound, and heals you for %s%% of the health removed.
names.item.simplyswords.emberlashsworditem.too: Attacking enemies inflicted with Smouldering causes you to deal an additional %d damage per stack.
Evade backwards while cauterising your wounds, healing for %d%% of Max HP.
names.item.simplyswords.waxweaversworditem.too: Attacking ignited enemies grants you Strength and Haste.
Encase an enemy in wax, preventing it from moving or attacking, and causing nearby enemies to attack it.
The wax prison detonates when it expires or its victim dies.
When you would die, you are instead imbued with magic wax, healing you to full and granting resistance for a short time.
This effect can only occur once every %ds. Mainhand only.
names.item.simplyswords.hiveheartsworditem.too: Release an angry bee on hit that stings your target before disappearing.
This effect can only occur once every %ds.
Release a swarm of tiny bees to harass nearby enemies, slowing and damaging them repeatedly.
names.item.simplyswords.starsedgesworditem.too: During the day, your attacks inflict %s additional damage.
At night, your attacks gain lifesteal.
Dash forward, and leave a constellation trail for a short duration.
The constellation trail damages enemies that touch it, and explodes each star for area damage when it expires.
names.item.simplyswords.wickpiercersworditem.t: Throw Wickpiercer, gaining frenzy stacks that grant attackspeed and allow you
Swing toward an enemy 3–12 blocks away to summon an airborne shadow clone that hurls an explosive spear at the target.
Rise into the air and command shadow clones to bombard the targeted area with Gloam spears.
names.item.simplyswords.tempestsworditem.toolt: Your attacks attach elemental energy to the target, causing damage over time and element specific debuffs.
Return all nearby elements to yourself, forming a vortex of elemental energy around you, damaging nearby enemies and growing in size.
names.item.simplyswords.dreadtidesworditem.too: Passively generate stacks of Voidcloak, increasing attack speed and reducing incoming damage by 10% per stack.
Taking damage removes a stack. Max 1 stack per 20 corruption.
Release your Voidcloak and send eldritch energy toward the nearest enemy, dealing rapid damage.
Wielding this weapon inflicts you with corruption over time.
names.item.simplyswords.flamewindsworditem.too: When a flame seed detonates, gain Haste.
Plant a seed of flame within the nearest enemy, dealing damage over time.
Upon expiring, the seed detonates, dealing area damage and spreading the effect to nearby enemies.
names.item.simplyswords.ribboncleaversworditem: Wielding Ribboncleaver causes you to move 5% slower, but take 15% less damage.
Dash forward, shrugging off the next few incoming hits, gaining knockback resistance, and causing your next attack to deal +95% damage to a single target.
names.item.simplyswords.riftmanesworditem.tool: Chance on swing to tear open a rift and loose a single spectral charger at a distant foe.
Split the air into a rank of spectral chargers that surge forward, goring and scattering everything in their path.
names.item.simplyswords.dawnquiversworditem.to: A lesser bow periodically fires at the most distant enemy you can see, and has a %d%% chance to grant Dawn Chorus.
Store up to %d Chorus on this weapon.
Hold to draw a great bow of light, firing an arrow based on your release timing and Dawn Chorus charges.
Dawn Volley - Spend 1 Chorus to loose a second arrow. %ss CD.
Sunlance - Spend 2 Chorus to pierce up to four enemies. %ss CD.
Seraphic Chorus - Spend 3 Chorus to summon three converging bows. %ss CD.
names.item.simplyswords.riftmanesworditem.tool: Using the ability while sprinting causes you to mount the central charger.
names.item.simplyswords.magiscythesworditem.to: Attacking enemies while Magistorm is active grants a chance to repair an equipped item.
A localised magical storm manifests above you, dealing damage to nearby enemies.
Each time the storm strikes, it has a chance to refresh its duration and increases its severity.
names.item.simplyswords.enigmasworditem.toolti: While you are near to your twister, gain Haste.
Summon a twister that chases down nearby enemies, dealing increased damage the longer an enemy remains trapped within.
names.item.simplyswords.magibladesworditem.too: The Magiblade occasionally detects and repels approaching enemies.
After charging, summon a Warden head that orbits you for %s seconds and periodically fires sonic waves at nearby enemies. Using the ability again refreshes its duration.
names.item.simplyswords.magispearsworditem.too: Chance on hit to deal additional magic damage.
Launch the Magispear skyward, calling down a rain of magic spears that damage enemies.
When the spear rain ends, leap to the target area to deliver a final slam attack.
names.item.simplyswords.caelestissworditem.too: Tear open a breach into another dimension, summoning corrupted creatures that fight for you.
The breach lasts %1$ds and expands to a %2$d block radius.
It collapses over its final %1$ds, pulling the summons back to their dimension. Each breach has a %2$d%% chance to release an Unbound creature that hunts you.
names.item.simplyswords.wraithfangsworditem.to: Throw Wraithfang and leap towards its position, briefly becoming immune to damage.
names.item.simplyswords.wraithmawsworditem.too: When collected, spectral cutlasses float above you, seeking targets when you swing your weapon.
Send a barrage of spectral cutlasses that leave Gloam where they land.
names.item.simplyswords.bloodwakesworditem.too: Hits inflict Bleed. Striking an enemy at maximum Bleed consumes it in a blood burst and grants Blood Frenzy.
The burst damages nearby enemies and inflicts Bleed around the target.
Consume all Blood Frenzy to invoke one of five blood rites.
More Frenzy invokes stronger rites: wake, scream, spectral blades, blood flies, and the Red Tide.
Blood bursts and blood waves stain the ground, slowing enemies and healing you while you stand in the blood.
names.item.simplyswords.chompolotlsworditem.to: Axolotls attack nearby enemies, and can be perched on your shoulders to provide area buffs.
A faint power seems to emanate from within.
A growing power seems to emanate from within.
names.item.simplyswords.levitationsworditem.to: Chance on hit to reverse the effects of gravity on your target.
names.item.simplyswords.speedsworditem.tooltip: Chance on hit to increase the wielders movespeed for a duration.
names.item.simplyswords.slownesssworditem.tool: Chance on hit to slow the target for a duration.
names.item.simplyswords.freezesworditem.toolti: Chance on hit to chill or freeze your target.
names.item.simplyswords.wildfiresworditem.tool: Chance on hit to ignite all nearby entities of the same type as your target.
names.item.simplyswords.zephyrsworditem.toolti: Chance on hit to gain attack and move speed.
names.item.simplyswords.shieldingsworditem.too: Chance on hit to gain absorption.
names.item.simplyswords.stoneskinsworditem.too: Chance on hit to increase your resistance at the cost of speed.
names.item.simplyswords.trailblazesworditem.to: Chance on hit to gain speed and ignite yourself.
names.item.simplyswords.weakensworditem.toolti: Chance on hit to slow and weaken your target.
names.item.simplyswords.unstablesworditem.tool: Regularly apply random effects to the wielder.
names.item.simplyswords.activedefencesworditem: Regularly fires arrows at nearby enemies (Requires Arrows).
names.item.simplyswords.frostwardsworditem.too: Regularly fires movement impairing snowballs at all nearby enemies.
names.item.simplyswords.momentumsworditem.tool: Gain a brief moment of strong forward momentum.
names.item.simplyswords.baneheadswarmsworditem: Periodically summon floating creeper heads that orbit you and home in on nearby enemies, exploding for area damage.
names.item.simplyswords.imbuedsworditem.toolti: Chance on hit to deal additional magic damage, scaling with durability.
names.item.simplyswords.stormlashsworditem.too: Chance on hit to chain lightning between nearby enemies.
names.item.simplyswords.dancingbladessworditem: Chance on hit to summon a clone of your weapon that orbits you and strikes nearby enemies.
names.item.simplyswords.faultlinesworditem.too: Chance on hit to split the earth in front of you, damaging enemies.
names.item.simplyswords.runicslashsworditem.to: Swing to send out a runic slash projectile that pierces targets, dealing weapon damage.
names.item.simplyswords.evocationsworditem.too: Periodically conjure evoker fangs beneath nearby enemies, slowing them and dealing weapon damage.
names.item.simplyswords.snifferslamsworditem.t: Chance on hit to summon a falling sniffer that crushes enemies, dealing heavy weapon damage and briefly immobilising them.
names.item.simplyswords.pincushionsworditem.to: Deal additional damage for each arrow stuck in your body.
names.item.simplyswords.wardsworditem.tooltip2: Sacrifice half your current HP to gain pulsing absorption relative to your remaining HP for 6 seconds.
names.item.simplyswords.immolationsworditem.to: Gain an aura of immolation, periodically damaging you and nearby foes. Outgoing damage scales with your current HP.
names.item.simplyswords.throwingsworditem.tool: Can be thrown, and has innate Loyalty III.
names.item.simplyswords.runic_tablet.tooltip: Can be used to craft and
names.item.simplyswords.runic_tablet.tooltip3: Can also be used to repair or upgrade Unique weapons.
names.item.simplyswords.uniquesworditem.nether: ◆  Echo
Your weapon swings echo, dealing additional unmitigated damage after a short delay.
◆  Berserk
When you have an armour value less than 10, your weapon swings siphon health from the target.
◆  Radiance
When hitting a target afflicted with weakness, gain Immolation for a short duration.
◆  Onslaught
When hitting a target afflicted with slowness, gain Onslaught for a short duration. (Onslaught grants you pulsing haste, but inflicts you with weakness when it expires).
◆  Nullification
Summons a Battle Standard on hit that periodically cleanses debuffs from allied players, while stripping buffs from enemies within its vicinity.
◆  Verdant Trail
Leave a trail of flowers that regenerate allies and harm enemies.
◆  Necromantic Arsenal
Chance on hit to summon a skeletal minion that fights with a copy of your weapon.
◆  Wolf Pack
Chance on hit to summon a wolf minion that fights with a copy of your weapon.
◆  Goat Stampede
Chance on hit to summon a stampede of goats that charge forward, knocking back and damaging anything in their path.
◆  Wing Buffet
Chance on hit to summon dragon wings that send forward a gust of wind, damaging and knocking back enemies in front of you.
◆  Dragon's Maw
Nearby enemies have a chance to cause you to summon a dragon head head that spews forth a damaging fire breath.
◆  Precise
Chance to gain several stacks of Precision when activating a signature ability.
◆  Mighty
Chance to gain several stacks of Might when activating a signature ability.
◆  Stealthy
Chance to gain Stealth when activating a signature ability.
◆  Renewed
When activating a signature ability, you have a chance to significantly reduce its cooldown.
◆  Accelerant
Berserker's Berserking signature ability no longer grants you Berserking, but its cooldown is reduced significantly.
◆  Leaping
When landing a Leap Slam you have a chance to immediately leap again.
◆  Spellshield
Chance on spell cast to gain Barrier.
◆  Spellforged
While in your mainhand, this weapon grants you increased spell power.
◆  Soulshock
While held, this weapon grants you increased Soul & Lightning spell power.
◆  Spell Standard
Chance on spell hit to drop a Spell Standard that grants Precision & Spellforged.
◆  War Standard
When using a forward charge ability, drop a War Standard that grants Might and reveals nearby enemies.
◆  Deception
When you evade an attack using Evasion Mastery, you have a chance to cleanse Revealed.
names.entity.simplyswords.battlestandard.name: %d's Battle Standard
